 News › News News › CBSE Date Sheet 2027 Classes 10, 12 Released! Over 46 lakh students registered for board exams CBSE Date Sheet 2027 Classes 10, 12 Released! Over 46 lakh students registered for board exams
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 7, 2026, 03:21 IST CBSE Date Sheet 2027 Released for Classes 10, 12; Over 46 Lakh Students Registered for Board Exams CBSE 10th, 12th Date Sheet 2027: Central Board of Secondary Education released CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 on its official website. Students appearing for CBSE Board Exams 2027 can now check and download official timetable in PDF format from cbse.gov.in.
 This year, more than 19.8 lakh students have registered for CBSE Class 12 board exams 2027 , while over 26.5 lakh students have registered for CBSE Class 10 exams 2027 . This takes the total number of registered students for CBSE Board Exams 2027 to more than 46 lakh.
 CBSE 10th, 12th date sheet 2027 contains subject-wise examination schedule for both classes, including the dates of individual papers. Students are advised to download the timetable and check their respective subject examination dates carefully to prepare their study schedules.
 CBSE Board Exam 2027: Important Dates 
 CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 board exams will commence on February 16, 2027 (Tuesday). The board has released the timetable 101 days before the commencement of the examinations.
 CBSE board exam will cover 83 subjects in Class 10 and 121 subjects in Class 12. CBSE has prepared the timetable after considering students' subject combinations, major entrance examination schedules and the availability of examination centres.

 CBSE Board Exam 2027 Timings 
 According to the official notification, all CBSE board examinations will commence at 10:30 am (IST). 
 However, the duration of the examination will vary depending on the subject. Most major subject examinations will be conducted from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm, while some papers will conclude at 12:30 pm.
 Students must check the examination duration mentioned against their respective subjects in official date sheet.
 CBSE stated that the early release of the date sheet was possible because schools submitted their List of Candidates (LOC) on time. The board has finalised the timetable based on the subject combinations selected by students.
 Steps to download CBSE Date Sheet 2027 PDF 
 Students can follow these steps to download the CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 timetable
 Visit the official website of CBSE at cbse.gov.in
 Go to the Latest @ CBSE or Examination section
 Click on the link for the CBSE Date Sheet 2027 for Class 10 and Class 12
 The timetable PDF will appear on the screen
 Check the subject-wise examination dates and timings
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference
